title: Acting since boyhood, day job, and family pictures
summary: He acted as a child and in school, says it helped with MCing, now works at Randolph Field, and shows pictures of his wife and young daughter.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: And when did you start acting?

Oh ever since I was a little boy I used to act around with the wonderful piano player, Wilhelmina Bartz, her sister, I can't remember her name, right? Gertrude I think it was. We were kids together and we acted on the stage. And in my school days, Valina C. Jones, I acted on a couple of plays there. Of course naturally after I got my band together I deviated from the stage until I settled here in San Antonio and I complied everything that I knew just as the hobby.
So you must have been, that acting ability must have been good, you know, in good stead for MCing and being the band director. It must have been made it good, huh?

Yes it did. It fit in just like a glove on the hand I imagine. Of course now I've had a varied life. I've thanked the Lord for many things that he blessed me with. Being a musician there's all the things that I could do. As you know I'm now working at Randolph Field.
What do you do out there, Don?

I'm a packer and creator for overseas shipments of engines and parts for the planes. Uh huh. Then there's a lot of other things that I have done in the line of work which makes everything come easy. It isn't hard when my music played out on me for me to get into some type of work to make myself a fairly good living. Happily married to the same woman for 31 or 32 years, but I love to tell the people it's over 65 because it seems it's been that long.
You told me the other night you got married two weeks ago or something.

Did you believe that? No. She changed it didn't she? This is my daughter, my last child. She's eight years old now. You see various stages of her life. She's danced on the stage since she's been a little top one year old. I had her dancing for the soldiers when I'd go out there and entertain them. I've done a lot of that work for them.
Is this about as old as she is now?
No, she was six years old here. She sure is a pretty child.
